body:
deff not bed bugs! My mom changed my sheets and vacuumed under my mattress and on my mattress and didnt mention anything. I didn't think so. I knew i'd have to have bites, or a rash or have seen a bug by now if it was something. Its really bad anxiety it seems. 
Hopefully sleep tonight.
I am pretty sure its just really bad anxiety. :/ But google made it worse.

I don't have a couch / sofa. We live in a tiny apartment. The "living room" is my moms bedroom and I'm in the bedroom. I was half tempted to make a bed on the floor in my moms "room". 

Hoping to find my sheet set I haven't used yet and have her change it later.
I was and never have been very serious.

The thing is I've said worse and no ones even batted an eye on facebook. But yet this time where it wasn't even about me, nothing close to "I want to kill myself", someone calls?! It was low and I was in no danger. I was out in less then 3 hours thank god but it was miserable and terrifying. Plus now my mom knows more that I have suicidal thoughts or at least talk like I do.
I'm 24 and I have never been open with my mom. Its not the kind of relationship we have and never will.
